error: One country claim carries a two-month period while its value is the full quarter's.
warning_texts: No deterministic rule in audit/check_plan.json compares a claim's own period field with the spec period: claims_recomputed filters raw by the dates frozen in the plan and caveats_declared matches wording only, so gate_claims_machine passed CLM-NET-CZ while its register entry names a two-month period

The published CLM-NET-CZ period label would mislead a reader of the release: 13527.24 EUR presented as January-February net revenue for CZ, when January-February CZ net is 9248.36 EUR and the remainder comes from March orders.

audit_spec.yaml sets the period end to 2025-03-30 while metrics/calculated_metrics.json names the period 2025-Q1-delivered; raw_data/orders.csv has no rows dated 2025-03-31, so no figure changes, but the quarter label and the stated end date disagree by one day.
summary: All five claim values recompute from raw_data/orders.csv and match both the register and gate_claims_machine within tolerance, but CLM-NET-CZ declares period 2025-01-01..2025-02-28 while its value 13527.24 is the net over the spec period 2025-01-01..2025-03-30; on its own stated period the figure would be 9248.36, so the claim states a period it was not calculated on.
